ix.about.heading: How to read this page
ix.tl.about.bars: A bar runs from the earliest to the latest date the record allows, as stored in the graph. A short bar is a precise record; a long one is either a long event or an uncertain date, and since the record does not say which, neither does the bar. Where a Hijri date was converted, a thin line shows how far the conversion may be off.
ix.tl.about.status: A date is recorded as a field of its record, so it usually carries no review status; where a claim in the graph attests a date, that claim's status is shown. Coverage says how complete the record is. Select a name to open its page, where every claim shows its status and source.
ix.tl.about.people: People are placed only by a recorded date of death: the graph records no dates of birth. People and groups with no recorded date are listed, not placed. “Focus on” lights up the items linked to one person, group or place; the year cursor lights up the items whose bounds overlap one year.
ix.tl.about.ah_axis: The AH row of the axis is worked out with the tabular Islamic calendar, the method the graph uses for its own conversions, so a year boundary may be a day or more off the calendar actually followed. It is a reading aid only: no record is dated by it.
ix.about.data: The drawing and this text are generated from the same data file, built from the graph. The view (years shown, year cursor, focus, selection, zoom) is kept in the page address, so a view can be shared as a link.
ix.about.download: Download the data behind this page (JSON)

ix.info.segment_field: A route segment is recorded as part of its route, not as a claim, so it has no review status. The coverage shown is the route record's.

ix.map.scene.places.other: The map shows {n} places at the coordinates their records give, between latitudes {south} and {north} and longitudes {west} and {east}.
ix.map.scene.no_places: No place in the graph has recorded coordinates, so the map shows land outlines only.
ix.map.scene.north: North is at the top. The land outlines come from Natural Earth and carry no historical information.

ix.map.scene.routes.other: {n} routes are recorded; {drawn} of their {segments} segments are drawn.

ix.map.scene.unplotted.other: {n} places have no recorded coordinates and are listed, not drawn.
ix.map.scene.events: Of the events and stories, {at} are recorded at a place on the map, {elsewhere} at places without coordinates, and {none} at no recorded place.
ix.map.off.heading: Not on the map
ix.map.off.other_geometry.one: Location recorded in a form this map does not draw (1)
ix.map.off.other_geometry.other: Location recorded in a form this map does not draw ({n})
ix.map.about.marks: A mark stands where the place's record puts it, at the coordinates stored in the graph; nothing is geocoded or estimated. Its shape says how the location was identified and its fill how sure the record is.
ix.map.about.routes: A route segment is drawn only along a geometry recorded for it. A segment without one, or of unknown confidence, is left as a gap, never joined up.
ix.map.about.status: A location is recorded as a field of its place, not as a claim, so it carries no review status; coverage says how complete the record is. Select a mark to see its record; select it again, or use the link, to open its page.
ix.map.about.projection: The projection is equirectangular, stretched east to west for the middle latitude of the places shown; north is at the top. The scale bar holds near that latitude.
ix.map.about.basemap: Land outlines: {source}, {licence}, simplified for this page.
